messages:
Ava (AE): DataHarbor wants a 10-day POC. Security questionnaire flags: SCIM bulk + delta guarantees, encrypted SAML assertions (they require RSA-OAEP + AES-256-GCM), multi-domain TXT proof, IdP->RBAC mapping, and question about Dedicated for SSO surges. Need quick takes.
Marcus (SE): SCIM: initial CSV bulk import for ~30k users + daily deltas ~2k. We support SCIM v2 PATCH and bulk ingest. We don't offer strict ordering for deltas by default; can recommend idempotency keys if they need strict ordering.
Leah (Security): SAML encryption: supported (assertion + NameID + attributes). We accept SP metadata with encryption cert. Algorithms requested are supported. For healthcare data, require customer-managed KMS for at-rest keys.
Noel (Infra): Private VPC POC = ~10 business days. Hosted with region pin + CMK = ~48-72h if we get KMS ARN and cross-account role.
Marcus (SE): RBAC mapping pattern: SCIM groups -> Redwood roles; SAML attribute claims -> session-scoped elevations. Ask them for sample group names and claim keys. Example mapping: "corp_admins" -> "org.admin".
Leah (Security): Session revocation on deprovision supported via webhook + token blacklist. Hosted best-effort propagation <60s typical; Dedicated can offer tighter SLA. Note: SP-side cookies may persist until client clears.
Sam (Legal): They requested SOC2 + DPA and explicit domain verification responsibility clause. We'll provide SOC2 report and standard DPA; will draft clause that customer must provision DNS TXT records for domain proof.
Ava (AE): Can SE/Sec/Infra prepare a 1-page FAQ for their infosec team and list of required artifacts?
Marcus (SE): I'll draft FAQ covering SCIM limits + bulk path, SAML encryption options, RBAC mapping examples, session revoke behavior, and artifacts (SP metadata, sample CSV first 500 rows, domains list, KMS ARN). EOD.
Noel (Infra): I'll post provisioning timelines and VPC checklist.
Leah (Security): Needed from customer: SP metadata XML, example CSV, KMS ARN (if CMK), list of domains to verify, desired session TTL, and any strict ordering requirements for SCIM.
Ava (AE): Thanks all 44d I'll collect and send to DataHarbor.
